_doc: Machine-readable duplicate-version cluster inventory for deny.toml [bans] (issue #2994). Each cluster is a single `cargo deny -f json check bans` diagnostic that reports `code=duplicate`. The count of clusters equals the live count of duplicate-version warnings emitted against the current Cargo.lock; the CI gate from #2933 enforces `deny.toml [bans] duplicates_baseline` (currently 45, matching `total_duplicates` here) and fails PRs that grow the count. Tracking issue #2994 carries the prose reduction plan; this artifact is the machine-readable baseline a future reduction PR must lower.
_rule: Per RULES.md 'no parameter tuning': do NOT raise `total_duplicates` or `duplicates_baseline` to hide a regression. Lower them only when a cluster is actually removed from the dep graph; commit the dep change together with the baseline update.
_duplicates_baseline_doc: Mirrors `# duplicates_baseline: 45` comment in deny.toml [bans]. The CI step in .github/workflows/security.yml parses that comment and fails when the live count exceeds this value. Issue #2994 reduces both in lock-step (45 -> 30 -> 15 -> 0).
_wildcards_baseline_doc: Number of wildcard-version warnings from `cargo deny check bans` (currently 1). The CI gate does NOT enforce this — only duplicates are gated per #2933. Listed here for completeness so future reduction PRs can track both axes.

milestones.label: v1.4-M1
milestones.strategy: Drop `bitflags 1.3.2` (legacy dep), `cpufeatures 0.2.17`, fold `directories 5`+`dirs-sys 0.4` chain, fold `hashbrown 0.15` (criterion plot bump), `foldhash 0.1`.

milestones.label: v1.4-M2
milestones.strategy: Bump `rustls 0.23` family + remove `r-efi 5.x` copy; align `getrandom 0.x` to a single major; align `winnow` to 0.7; fold `thiserror 1.x` to 2.x.

milestones.label: v1.4-M3
milestones.strategy: Bump `windows-*` family to a single major (likely 0.61); align `nalgebra`/`simba`/`wide` to 0.35/0.10/1.x; align `syn` to 2.x or 3.x. Then flip deny.toml `multiple-versions = 'deny'` and migrate unavoidable entries to `skip` with `reason`.

clusters.name: windows-sys-family
clusters.source: transitive via faer 0.24 (0.42), directories 5 (0.48), rustls 0.23 / hyper-rustls / reqwest / tokio-rustls / memory-stats (0.52), anstream/colored/tempfile (0.61)
clusters.removal_strategy: Requires bumping the entire windows-* family to a single major (likely 0.61) OR a workspace-wide [patch.crates-io] align. Not trivially removable — surfaces at M3.

clusters.name: rand-family
clusters.source: rand 0.8 (rustls et al.) + rand 0.9 (reqwest -> getrandom 0.3 path); getrandom 0.1 pulled transitively by rand 0.8 (issue text) — current Cargo.lock resolves 0.2/0.3/0.4 instead.
clusters.removal_strategy: Resolves once rustls and reqwest align on rand 0.9 (M2).

clusters.name: directories-family
clusters.source: directories 5 (fluxion direct) + directories 6 (font-kit via plotters -> criterion); dirs-sys tracks the same split.
clusters.removal_strategy: Resolves once plotters/font-kit move off directories 5 (M1).

clusters.name: thiserror-family
clusters.removal_strategy: Requires bumping the entire thiserror 1.x dependency chain (gemm/faer/sysctl/redox_users, plus plotters' transitive). M2.

clusters.name: nalgebra-family
clusters.source: nalgebra 0.33 (statrs) + nalgebra 0.35 (workspace) + matching lineage in ndarray / simba / wide / equator / equator-macro.
clusters.removal_strategy: Requires bumping statrs (or removing it) and aligning the simba/equator chain. M3.

clusters.name: uom
clusters.removal_strategy: Resolves once fluxion is bumped to uom 0.38 (M1).

clusters.name: r-efi
clusters.source: r-efi 5.x + r-efi 6.x both pulled by rustls 0.23.x depending on patch release.
clusters.removal_strategy: Resolves once rustls pin is updated to a single r-efi major (M2).

clusters.name: bitflags
clusters.removal_strategy: Identify the lone remaining 1.3.2 transitive; `cargo update` or workspace pin (M1, lowest-effort candidate).

clusters.name: hashbrown
clusters.removal_strategy: Resolves once criterion plot bumps to hashbrown 0.16 (M1).

clusters.name: single-version-pairs
clusters.source: various transitive sources — each is a single dependency bump candidate.
clusters.removal_strategy: Tackle per crate, lowest-effort first. `cpufeatures`, `bitflags` (M1) and `winnow` (M2) are the natural first targets.
